blocked.project: Enter a project name and at least one floor.
blocked.wallRef: Draw a reference box on a wall.

project.title: Project
project.hint: Project name and floors. Address is optional. Then run detection per floor.
project.name: Project name
project.heightsHint: Per floor. New floors start with the active floor’s values.

errors.keepOneFloor: At least one floor must remain.
errors.noFloorReadyForFml: No floor ready for FML export yet.

input.welcomeLead: Start with your underlay. You pick the detection profile in step 3.
input.welcomeHint: After upload you go through Underlay and Preprocess to Detection.
input.underlayHint: Download the current image (crop/erase + rotation) as PNG. Edit locally and re-upload — then set rotation to 0° (already baked into the PNG). Scale is set per upload. Draw references in step 2 (Preprocess).
input.reuseUnderlayHintOk: Takes the project source (original scan + scale lines, without crop). Available after confirming scale on an earlier floor. Crop this floor again afterward.
input.reuseUnderlayHintBlocked: First confirm scale on a floor (before crop) to keep the project source.

pdf.title: Choose PDF page
pdf.lead: Select the page to use as underlay.
pdf.passwordProtected: This PDF is password-protected. Export an unprotected version first.
pdf.loadFailed: Could not load PDF. Check that the file is valid.
pdf.convertFailed: Could not convert PDF to image.

errors.projectSourceExpired: Project source expired (blob URL). Confirm scale again on the first floor, or re-upload the scan.
errors.noProjectSource: No project source yet. First confirm scale on a floor (before crop) — then you can reuse it here.
errors.loadDrawingFirst: Load a PNG/JPG floor plan first.

preprocess.bwHint: Fixed B/W (default 150), then automatic adaptive. No grayscale to detection.
preprocess.preBinarizeCheck: Pre-binarize to B/W (no gray → always adaptive after)
preprocess.negativeHint: Inverts the processed B/W plan as the last step (after cleanup).
preprocess.inkWallHint: Read-only B/W used during wall classification for ink comparison on white faces (Otsu reference). This is not the Preprocess B/W — tune that on that tab.

inkWallParams.holeFill: Hole-fill / thicken: scaled to wall thickness

refs.title: References
refs.hint: Tune B/W first, then draw reference boxes on the same image. Wall: 1 selection (thickness measured on finish). Door/window: multiple. After a box, back to pan; click Wall/Door/Window again to continue. Escape or click the active button to stop drawing. Shift+click removes a box. Reference analysis: Debug sidebar → «Export reference analysis».
refs.ocrOffHint: OCR off: no auto-scan on Walls. Details later via Dev view.
refs.ocrOnHint: OCR on: auto-scan on Walls during detection; details via Dev view.
refs.noThicknessYet: No wall thickness yet — measured when finishing preprocess.
refs.doorTemplateHint: Per reference: standard door or closet door. Double doors and windows are determined later by the algorithm.

ocrSettings.title: OCR
ocrSettings.disabledHint: OCR is off — enable it in step 2 (Preprocess).

preprocess.copyBwHint: Copies B/W tune only (and measured wall thickness if known). Redraw reference boxes after crop — coordinates from another floor won’t match.

stamp.title: Wall stamp
stamp.hint: FML walls from another floor as a stamp on this B/W. Align on canvas (handles), erase, then bake → adaptive B/W + black Otsu-OR.

stampErrors.noWallsInBands: No walls in the selected thickness bands.
stampErrors.noFmlWalls: No FML walls on the chosen floor.

errors.noDonorPreprocess: No floor with preprocess to reuse.
errors.drawWallRef: Draw a reference box on a wall.
errors.measureThicknessFailed: Could not measure wall thickness in the reference box. Redraw over a clear wall.
errors.bwUnavailableForMeasure: Wall B/W not available for thickness measurement.

walls.thicknessMissing: No wall thickness — draw a reference box in step 1.
walls.inkStale: Toolbar ink changed: process ink — only affected faces are reclassified.

ocrOnWalls.title: OCR
ocrOnWalls.hint: Text highlights are active (not baked yet). Adjust confidence, clear, or bake to ink.

status.colorsReady: Colors ready — review faces and finish detection.
status.profileChanged: Profile changed — regenerate detection per tab.
status.needReference: First measure a wall reference via Auto-classify.
status.needReferenceOrBox: First measure a wall reference via the box or Auto-classify.
status.classifyNotStarted: Wall classification did not start — check profile (Solid/Open) and try again.
status.swallowedErrors: Detection done, but {count} error(s) were swallowed — see Layer Debug journal ({where}).

errors.confirmScaleFirst: Confirm scale with ✓ before starting detection.
errors.pipelineNotLoaded: Detection pipeline not loaded (noop). Restart the app — worker must register geometry-lbe.
errors.finalizeFailed: Finishing detection failed — classification kept. Try again or reload the page.
errors.noBwForInk: No wall B/W available for processing ink.
errors.noTextFound: No text found — adjust confidence or mode.
errors.enableOcr: Enable OCR text detection to scan.

result.needScale: Confirm scale first to see the FML preview.
result.needFinalize: Finish wall detection for the FML preview.
result.clipboardUnavailable: Copy to clipboard is not available in this browser/context.
result.bovenlichtTitle: 40 cm high, 10 cm above the door, same width. Only in FML export (not in preview). Overridable per door via Ctrl+click.
result.thicknessMinTitle: Export thickness for walls in the min band
result.thicknessMidTitle: Export thickness for walls in the mid band
result.thicknessMaxTitle: Export thickness for walls in the max band
result.pickMinTitle: Measure min band boundary on underlay (measured × 1.10)
result.pickMaxTitle: Measure max band boundary on underlay (measured × 0.90)
result.bandHint: Measure band: min < {mid} · mid {mid}–{max} · max > {max} cm
result.doorHeightTitle: Default for all doors; overridable per door via Ctrl+click in the preview
result.windowSillTitle: Default floor → bottom of window; overridable per window via Ctrl+click
result.windowGlassTitle: Default glass height; overridable per window via Ctrl+click in the preview
result.overrideHint: Override per opening: Ctrl+click in the preview → size/height.
result.dirtyHint: Height/thickness changed — click Regenerate to update the FML.

thicknessPick.clickWall: Click a wall to set the {tier} measure band (±10%).
thicknessPick.retry: Click a wall again for the {tier} measure band.
thicknessPick.noUnderlay: Underlay missing — upload and confirm scale before measuring.
thicknessPick.measureFailed: Measurement failed — underlay or wall unavailable.

toolbar.hintDefault: Choose selection tool · space + drag = pan · double-click + drag = slide (perpendicular to wall) · Ctrl+click = (de)select · Esc = deselect · corner = drag (snaps to other ends) · Ctrl+drag = without snap
toolbar.hintMeasure: Drag between 2 points for a dimension · Shift = horizontal/vertical · snaps to corners · Esc = cancel/clear dimensions · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintDrawWall: Drag wall line · soft-snap to corners · Shift = horizontal/vertical · space + drag = pan · Esc = cancel
toolbar.hintDrawRoom: Drag rectangular room · soft-snap to corners · start on existing endpoint to link · corner on existing wall splits that wall · Shift = square · Esc = cancel
toolbar.hintAddDoor: Click a wall to place a door · choose type and size · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintAddWindow: Click a wall to place a window · choose type, width, sill and glass height · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintBoxSelect: Drag box — walls fully inside selection · Shift/Ctrl+box = add · Ctrl+click = (de)select · Esc = deselect · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintWallOne: 1 wall selected · adjust thickness/alignment · space + drag = pan · double-click + drag = slide (perpendicular) · Ctrl+click = (de)select · Ctrl+corner-drag = without snap
toolbar.hintWallMany: {count} walls selected · adjust thickness/alignment or delete the group · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintDoorOne: 1 door selected · adjust size/height/mirror · copy to place again · drag = move along wall · Ctrl+click = (de)select
toolbar.hintDoorMany: {count} doors selected · adjust settings or delete selection · space + drag = pan
toolbar.hintWindowOne: 1 window selected · adjust width/sill/glass · copy to place again · drag = move along wall · Ctrl+click = (de)select
toolbar.hintWindowMany: {count} windows selected · adjust settings or delete selection · space + drag = pan
toolbar.bovenlichtTitle: 40 cm high, 10 cm above the door — FML export only, not in preview
toolbar.hingeAtStart: Hinge: start — click to set to end
toolbar.hingeAtEnd: Hinge: end — click to set to start
toolbar.swingRight: Swing: right — click to set left
toolbar.swingLeft: Swing: left — click to set right
toolbar.copyOpeningTitle: Copy — activates place tool with the same settings

canvasHints.panZoomChooseType: Drag = pan · scroll = zoom · choose type on the left to draw a box
canvasHints.polygon: Click points · double-click or first point = close · Enter = done · Esc = cancel
canvasHints.eraserMode: Click + drag to erase · space + drag = pan · scroll = zoom
canvasHints.drawRef: Drag box on drawing ({type}) · space + drag = pan · Shift+click on box = delete
canvasHints.drawRefShort: Drag box on drawing ({type}) · space + drag = pan
canvasHints.faceSelect: Shift + click a white face = toggle classification · drag = pan · space + drag = pan · scroll = zoom
canvasHints.probePoint: Click the drawing for pixel coordinates · space + drag = pan · scroll = zoom
canvasHints.probeRegion: Drag a window on the drawing · space + drag = pan · scroll = zoom
canvasHints.selection: Click box to select · drag edges = edit · Shift+click = delete · icon right = delete
canvasHints.selectionWithMove: Click box to select · drag edges = edit · icon left = move · icon right = delete

settings.title: Default settings
settings.hint: Heights and wall thicknesses apply to new projects and “Reset to defaults” on step 0. Scale unit only affects typing on the scale rulers (step 1); calculations stay in mm. Opening merge and opacities apply on the FML page (step 4); open projects pick them up when you return from settings.
settings.scaleUnitHint: Only for typing distances on the H/V scale rulers in step 1. Internal calculation remains millimeters.
settings.thicknessHint: FML output thicknesses (min/mid/max). Measure bands come from the wall reference.
settings.fmlConversionHint: Automatically merge adjacent detected singles into double doors or double/triple windows when generating FML. Manual add in the editor is always available.
settings.mergeDoubleDoors: Merge adjacent doors into double doors
settings.parseNotObject: Settings file is not an object

hints.faceUnknown: Drag a box — faces fully inside the selection become unknown
hints.faceWall: Drag a box — faces fully inside the selection become wall
hints.staleUnderlay: Underlay changed — click «Process changes» in the sidebar
